chapter: Rudolph's band, Joe Petit and the voice band
title: Band with Sidney Fluesa, Rudolph and Gilbert Young
summary: He lists a six-piece band with Rudolph, Al Seed, Sidney Fluesa, Gilbert Young and two trombonists named Morris French.
